_: NC-3 of the Knight Foundation cities program. Charlotte and Mecklenburg County, 28 seats.
_name_form: The voter-facing form is the one the body's OWN CURRENT ROSTER uses. Where the council history PDF or a GIS layer spells a name differently, both forms are recorded in alternates -- the roster page is what a voter sees, and the others are how the same person appears in a record.
_precision: start_precision is what the SOURCE supports, never what could be inferred. NC seats county officers on the first Monday in December and the BOCC publishes that date for every term, so day precision is AVAILABLE for the officers by inference -- it is deliberately not written as fact.
_inclusion: Ruling (Cantrell, 2026-09-17): an office is seated if the voters of that jurisdiction elect it. That is why the District Attorney and three Soil & Water supervisors are here, and why Soil & Water's two STATE-APPOINTED supervisors (Daniel Austin, Eliseo Pascual) are not.

deferred.what: District Court Judge and Superior Court Judge
deferred.why: Mecklenburg voters elect both, so the ruling includes them, but Superior Court sits in sub-county districts whose geometry production does not hold, the bench size must come from G.S. 7A-41 rather than a ballot page, and the Board of Elections and the statute disagree on the sub-district labels (26-C/26-F/26-H against 26A/26B/26C). Own wave, covering every NC county.
